title: Fix MDX component type incompatibility with React 19
body:
Vercel builds failing with TypeScript error in `mdx-components.tsx`. React 19's `FC` type returns `ReactNode | Promise<ReactNode>` for Server Component support, but `@types/mdx` expects `ReactNode`.

## Changes

- Added type assertion `as MDXComponents` to `useMDXComponents` return value

```typescript
export function useMDXComponents(components: MDXComponents): MDXComponents {
  return {
    ...defaultComponents,
    ...components,
  } as MDXComponents;
}
```

Type assertion is safe—fumadocs components are MDX-compatible at runtime, structural typing ensures shape correctness.
